bread.lore.rare: Rises again in the bag every night, so the loaf is a little taller every morning and never fits the bread bin.
bread.lore.epic: Was sliced so thin for a picnic that the wind blew the sandwiches into the next field, and the cows had lunch.
bread.lore.legendary: Stayed fresh for a whole year out of pure stubbornness, then went stale the second someone wanted a sandwich.

x_panini.lore.rare: Pulls the cheese out of every other sandwich in the cafe to fill itself up.
x_panini.lore.legendary: Was pressed so hard in the grill that it came out thinner than a page, and it was posted to Gran as a birthday card.

x_sandwich_roll.lore.rare: Swaps its filling with the roll next to it in the lunchbox, so ham becomes jam by lunchtime.
x_sandwich_roll.lore.epic: Was sat on by Dad on the coach, came out flat as a pancake, and the family ate it rolled up like a carpet.
x_sandwich_roll.lore.legendary: Was stuffed so full that the whole picnic fitted inside it, blanket included, and the ants needed a map to find the jam.
x_sandwich_roll.names.legendary: Picnicus, the Roll That Ate a Picnic

cake.lore.rare: Makes whoever cuts it sing 'Happy Birthday', even when it is nobody's birthday.
cake.lore.epic: Leaned so far on the way to the table that it toppled onto the dog, who wore it as a hat for the rest of the party.
cake.lore.legendary: Was baked with so many layers that the top one had its own weather, and the candles had to be lit from a ladder.

x_birthday_candle.lore.epic: Was blown out so hard that the wish flew into the next room and came true for the cat.
x_birthday_candle.lore.legendary: Was blown out with a wish for 'more birthdays', and now the family has one every Tuesday.

x_cake_pop.lore.rare: Sends its sprinkles marching off in a line across the table whenever nobody is watching.
x_cake_pop.lore.epic: Got its stick tangled in the birthday girl's hair, and she wore it as a hair clip all afternoon.
x_cake_pop.lore.legendary: Popped so high off its stick that it went into orbit, and on clear nights it twinkles with sprinkles.

candy.lore.uncommon: Has its wrapper twisted so tightly that it takes a whole film to open.
candy.lore.rare: Makes anyone who eats one talk in a squeaky voice for exactly one minute.
candy.lore.epic: Burst out of a pinata in such a rainbow that the garden looked like a sweet hailstorm, and the umbrellas came out.
candy.lore.legendary: Was shared so fairly between six children that nobody argued, and all the parents fainted in shock.

x_caramel.lore.legendary: Melted into a golden puddle so big that the town skated on it once it set, and everyone's skates stuck.

x_chewing_gum.lore.rare: Sticks itself back under the same desk no matter how many times it is scraped off.
x_chewing_gum.lore.epic: Blew a bubble so big in assembly that it popped and stuck the front row's hair together.
x_chewing_gum.lore.legendary: Blew a bubble so huge that it lifted its chewer off the playground, and the school had to reel him back in on a kite string.

x_gummy.lore.rare: Wobbles off the table on its own when nobody is looking and hides in the sofa cushions.
x_gummy.lore.epic: Was squeezed so hard that it shot out of its eater's fingers and stuck to the classroom ceiling, where it still wobbles.
x_gummy.lore.legendary: Squished itself flat to slip under the door, popped back into a bear on the other side, and the bag never saw it again.

x_jelly_beans.lore.rare: Changes flavour halfway through being chewed, so strawberry becomes sprout without warning.
x_jelly_beans.lore.epic: Spilled out of the jar across the school hall, and the whole assembly slid about like a disco.

x_licorice.lore.rare: Ties itself into knots in the bag, so getting one out takes a whole car journey.
x_licorice.lore.epic: Was used as a skipping rope at break, and the rope got shorter every turn because somebody kept nibbling it.
x_licorice.lore.legendary: Turned every tongue in town black for a week, so the school photo looks like a row of happy panthers.

x_lollipop_swirl.lore.rare: Hypnotises anyone who stares at its swirl, so the whole queue at the fair walks round in circles.
x_lollipop_swirl.lore.epic: Was dropped on the fairground carousel and stuck so firmly that it now goes round with the horses.

x_mint.lore.rare: Makes anyone who eats it whistle by accident on every word with an S in it.
x_mint.lore.epic: Was passed round after dinner, and the whole table breathed out so coldly that the candles froze.
x_mint.lore.legendary: Was crunched so loudly at a quiet dinner that the sound froze in the air, and the guests hung their coats on it.

x_toffee.lore.uncommon: Gets stuck to its own wrapper, so half of every piece is eaten with a bit of paper.
x_toffee.lore.rare: Shatters like glass when tapped, and the pieces fly so far that the hammer has to wear goggles.
x_toffee.lore.epic: Was so hard that it broke the little hammer, then the big hammer, then the neighbour's hammer.
x_toffee.lore.legendary: Was so hard that it outlasted the castle wall it was stuck to, and the builders now order it by the tonne.

x_truffle.lore.uncommon: Hides a surprise filling inside its shell, so the strawberry one always turns out to be coffee.
x_truffle.lore.rare: Melts on purpose in the hand of anyone who is about to share it.
x_truffle.lore.epic: Was the last truffle in the box, and the family argued so long that it got bored and ate itself.
x_truffle.lore.legendary: Was so rich that it bought the chocolate shop it came from and handed out free samples on its first day as owner.
x_truffle.names.legendary: Ganache Grande, Owner of the Shop

x_brownie.lore.rare: Grows a crispy corner wherever it is cut, so there is never a middle piece.
x_brownie.lore.epic: Was baked so gooey for the bake sale that the tray slid off the table and set as a chocolate path across the hall.
x_brownie.lore.legendary: Was so gooey in the middle that a teaspoon fell in and came out on the other side of the world.

chocolate.lore.rare: Melts only for its owner, and stays rock hard in the hand of anyone trying to pinch a square.
chocolate.lore.epic: Melted on the classroom radiator and dripped into the shape of the teacher's face, smiling for once.
chocolate.lore.legendary: Snapped into so many squares that it tiled the whole kitchen floor, and the family ate its way to the fridge.

x_fudge.lore.rare: Turns any spoon left in it into fudge, so the cutlery drawer is slowly becoming pudding.
x_fudge.lore.epic: Was sold on the pier in a slab so heavy that the pier tilted, and the fishing boats got a free sample.
x_fudge.lore.legendary: Was so sweet that the sea round the pier turned to syrup, and the waves now break in slow motion.

cookie.lore.rare: Hides its chocolate chips whenever anyone counts them, so every cookie seems to have just one.
cookie.lore.epic: Crumbled so badly on a train that the pigeons at every station knew which carriage to wait at.
cookie.lore.legendary: Was baked so big and round that it was mistaken for a full moon, and the wolves howled at it all night.

x_fortune_cookie.lore.rare: Makes its fortunes come true, but only the small ones, so 'you will find treasure' means a coin under the sofa.
x_fortune_cookie.lore.epic: Gave the whole table the fortune 'look behind you', and they all turned round at once and knocked over the noodles.
x_fortune_cookie.lore.legendary: Predicted rain on sports day so firmly that the clouds felt they had to turn up.

x_gingerbread_man.lore.rare: Bakes himself a little friend out of his own crumbs whenever someone takes a bite.
x_gingerbread_man.lore.epic: Led a whole tray of gingerbread on a getaway across the kitchen, and the fox from the story asked them for directions.
x_gingerbread_man.lore.legendary: Ran so far that he outran the fox, the river and the end of his own story, and now nobody knows how it finishes.

x_macaron.lore.rare: Has a shell so delicate that it cracks if anyone so much as says 'crunch' nearby.
x_macaron.lore.epic: Was stacked into a tower at a fancy tea, and one sneeze sent the whole rainbow rolling under the piano.
x_macaron.lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a famous painting, and now it hangs in a gallery with a guard watching it slowly soften.

x_sugar_cookie.lore.rare: Rearranges its own icing when nobody is looking, so the smiley face is a frowny face by teatime.
x_sugar_cookie.lore.epic: Was iced so thickly at a party that it turned into a skateboard, and the birthday boy rode it to the bus stop.
x_sugar_cookie.lore.legendary: Was cut into a star so perfect that it floated up into the night sky, and there is now a constellation that smells of vanilla.

x_wafer.lore.rare: Plays a different note for every layer when tapped, like a tiny xylophone.
x_wafer.lore.epic: Snapped so loudly in a quiet cinema that the film stopped, rewound and started again from the beginning.
x_wafer.lore.legendary: Was stacked into a tower so tall that the harbour used it as a lighthouse until a hungry storm ate it.

croissant.lore.uncommon: Sheds one flake into every keyboard, pocket and car seat it passes.
croissant.lore.rare: Points its horns at whoever ate the last one, so nobody can pretend it wasn't them.
croissant.lore.legendary: Was so buttery that it slid out of the bakery, down the high street and into the harbour, where it is now a boat.

cupcake.lore.rare: Puffs out a cloud of icing sugar when bitten, and its eater sneezes sprinkles.
cupcake.lore.epic: Was stacked in a party tower, and when someone took one from the bottom, the whole tower rained onto the bouncy castle.
cupcake.lore.legendary: Had icing so tall that a mountaineer climbed it, planted a flag and had to be rescued with a teaspoon.

donut.lore.rare: Rolls away on its edge like a wheel whenever someone reaches for it.
donut.lore.epic: Was dunked in hot chocolate and floated round the mug like a rubber ring, with a marshmallow sunbathing in the middle.
donut.lore.legendary: Was so big that the town turned it into a roundabout, and the cars go round it licking their lips.

fried_egg.lore.common: Spreads across the pan until it touches the sausages, then refuses to let go.
fried_egg.lore.rare: Shines its yolk like a little torch, so it can be found in a dark kitchen at midnight.
fried_egg.lore.legendary: Shone its yolk so brightly at breakfast that the sun thought it had been replaced and went back to bed.

x_omelette.lore.rare: Folds itself over anything left on the plate, so the peas, the fork and the salt cellar all get tucked in.
x_omelette.lore.epic: Was flipped so hard in a cafe that it wrapped itself round the chef like a yellow scarf.
x_omelette.lore.legendary: Was cooked in a pan so big that the whole town used it as a duvet on the coldest night of the year.

x_scrambled_eggs.lore.rare: Scrambles anything near the pan, so the shopping list and the crossword come out jumbled.
x_scrambled_eggs.lore.epic: Was made with so many eggs that the hens next door went on strike until they got a thank-you card.
x_scrambled_eggs.lore.legendary: Was scrambled so fast that it unscrambled itself back into twelve whole eggs, and the cook had to start again.

fries.lore.rare: Points like a compass at the nearest bottle of ketchup, even in someone else's house.
fries.lore.legendary: Stayed hot for the walk home, then for the whole winter, and the family used the cone as a heater.

x_frozen_yogurt.lore.rare: Gives anyone who eats it too fast a brain freeze so strong that they forget what day it is.
x_frozen_yogurt.lore.epic: Swirled out of the machine without stopping, and the morning staff had to dig their way into the shop.
x_frozen_yogurt.lore.legendary: Was swirled so tall that snow settled on top, and a skier came down it with chocolate flakes on his hat.

x_gelato_cup.lore.uncommon: Comes with a spoon so tiny that eating it takes longer than the holiday.
x_gelato_cup.lore.rare: Changes flavour to match the weather, so a rainy day gets a scoop of puddle.
x_gelato_cup.lore.epic: Was served in a cup so big that the family had to hire a pedalo to reach the bottom.
x_gelato_cup.lore.legendary: Was so good that a family missed their flight home, and they now live above the gelato shop.

ice_cream.lore.uncommon: Falls off the cone at the very first lick and lands scoop-side down.
ice_cream.lore.rare: Drips only on whoever is wearing their best clothes, and it can find them across a whole beach.
ice_cream.lore.epic: Melted into a river on the hottest day, and a family of ducks paddled away in the empty cone.
ice_cream.lore.legendary: Was piled with so many scoops that the cone reached the clouds, and every cloud over town now tastes of strawberry.

x_sundae.lore.rare: Puts a cherry on top of anything near it, so the soup, the homework and Dad's head all get one.
x_sundae.lore.epic: Toppled at the ice-cream parlour and buried the counter, and the staff dug out two spoons and a surprised waiter.
x_sundae.lore.legendary: Was so tall that the girl eating it started at breakfast and reached the bottom on her birthday.

x_pizza_slice_box.lore.uncommon: Always has one slice with all the olives, and it is always the one left at the end.
x_pizza_slice_box.lore.rare: Turns any box stacked on it into pizza, so the shoe box and the cereal box now come with cheese.
x_pizza_slice_box.lore.epic: Was left on a car roof and flew off down the road like a frisbee, and a lorry driver caught it with one hand.
x_pizza_slice_box.lore.legendary: Folded itself into a paper aeroplane and delivered its own pizza across town before the shop had even picked up the phone.

popcorn.lore.legendary: Kept popping after the bag was empty until the kitchen was full to the ceiling, and the family had to eat its way out.

x_gyro.lore.uncommon: Hides a few chips inside its pita, and one always falls out first.
x_gyro.lore.epic: Was wrapped so tight at a festival that it popped like a party cracker and showered the stage with lettuce.
x_gyro.lore.legendary: Held so much sauce that when it finally burst, it painted the festival field white and the planes thought it had snowed.

x_quesadilla_plate.lore.epic: Folded so hard that it snapped shut on the spatula and wouldn't let go until it got more cheese.
x_quesadilla_plate.lore.legendary: Was so crispy that its crunch was heard across the desert, and a camel came to ask for a wedge.

x_shawarma.lore.epic: Was so garlicky that the vampire film on the takeaway's TV switched itself off.
x_shawarma.lore.legendary: Grew on its spit until it was as tall as the shop, and the owner now climbs a ladder to slice the top.

taco.lore.rare: Holds its shape only while someone is looking at it, and folds flat the moment its eater blinks.
taco.lore.epic: Crunched so loudly at taco night that the smoke alarm went off and the dog hid in the bath.
taco.lore.legendary: Was folded so big that a whole family slept inside it on a camping trip, with a zip made of cheese.

x_wrap_sandwich.lore.rare: Rolls itself tighter whenever anyone tries to take a bite, until it is as hard as a rolling pin.
x_wrap_sandwich.lore.epic: Was wrapped in so much foil that it set off the airport scanner, and the whole queue waited while it was unwrapped.
x_wrap_sandwich.lore.legendary: Wrapped itself round a runaway shopping trolley and stopped it at the bottom of the hill without losing a single pea.

x_apple_pie.lore.rare: Turns any apple left in the fruit bowl into a pie overnight, so the fruit bowl is now a pie dish.
x_apple_pie.lore.legendary: Had a crust so big that it became the roof of the village hall, and now the rain smells of cinnamon.

x_bao_bun.lore.rare: Bounces back so hard when squeezed that it boings out of the steamer and onto the next table.
x_bao_bun.lore.epic: Was steamed so fluffy that the restaurant used it as a cushion, and two customers sat on their lunch.
x_bao_bun.lore.legendary: Rose in the steamer so high that it lifted the restaurant off the ground, and the waiters now serve lunch in parachutes.

x_biscuit_tin.lore.rare: Holds sewing things whenever a child opens it, and biscuits whenever a grown-up does.
x_biscuit_tin.lore.epic: Was opened so hard at a family party that the lid rolled down the hall, out of the door and into next door's party.
x_biscuit_tin.lore.legendary: Was so hard to open that a crane and the strongest man in town both gave up, and Gran opened it with a teaspoon.

x_butter.lore.rare: Goes rock hard the moment anyone wants to spread it, and melts the moment they give up.
x_butter.lore.epic: Was left out so long in summer that it slid off the table, out through the cat flap and down the garden.
x_butter.lore.legendary: Spread so smoothly straight from the fridge that it buttered a whole loaf in one swipe, and the toaster gave a little bow.

x_calzone.lore.rare: Hides a different pizza inside every time it is cut, so nobody ever knows what they ordered.
x_calzone.lore.epic: Erupted so much cheese when it was cut that the party moved into the garden and ate the lava with forks.
x_calzone.lore.legendary: Folded itself round a whole pizza restaurant, and the diners finished their meal inside without noticing.

x_candy_floss.lore.rare: Spins any hair it touches into more candy floss, so the hairdresser now sells it by the bag.
x_candy_floss.lore.epic: Was blown off its stick at the seaside and wrapped the lifeguard's chair in pink, with the lifeguard still in it.
x_candy_floss.lore.legendary: Was spun so big at the fair that it became the new big top, and the circus moved in.

x_cheese.lore.rare: Ages a whole year every time the fridge door is opened, so it is now older than Grandad.
x_cheese.lore.epic: Was unwrapped on a train, and the whole carriage moved next door, leaving the cheese a first-class seat to itself.
x_cheese.lore.legendary: Smelled so strong that the harbour used it as a foghorn, and the ships now steer by nose.

x_cheese_wedge.lore.rare: Moves its holes around overnight, so the slice you cut is never the slice you expected.
x_cheese_wedge.lore.legendary: Had so many holes that the wind whistled through it, and the town band now plays it as a flute.

x_cheesecake_slice.lore.rare: Weighs ten times more than it looks, so the waiter's tray tips over every time it is served.
x_cheesecake_slice.lore.epic: Wobbled off its plate at a party and skied down the tablecloth into Grandad's lap.
x_cheesecake_slice.lore.legendary: Was so rich and heavy that when it was dropped, the earthquake machine across town recorded a small cheesequake.

x_chocolate_box.lore.rare: Swaps its chocolates round whenever someone checks the map, so the toffee is always the coffee one.
x_chocolate_box.lore.epic: Was passed round a party so slowly that the person at the end found only the map and a coffee cream.

x_churro.lore.rare: Grows longer every time it is dunked, so the last dip always needs a bigger cup.
x_churro.lore.epic: Was so long and crisp that Grandad used it as a walking stick to the fair and back.
x_churro.lore.legendary: Was piped so long at the fair that it went round the big wheel, and riders snapped off a piece as they passed.

x_cinnamon_roll.lore.rare: Spins like a top when set down, and doesn't stop until somebody says 'cinnamon'.
x_cinnamon_roll.lore.legendary: Unrolled itself into one ribbon of dough long enough to wrap the town hall like a present.

x_cotton_candy.lore.epic: Floated off at the carnival and got tangled round the trapeze, so the acrobats swung through a pink cloud all night.
x_cotton_candy.lore.legendary: Drifted across the sea and was found by a lighthouse keeper two countries away, still on its stick.

x_cream_puff.lore.uncommon: Collapses into a sad pancake if anyone opens the oven door too early.
x_cream_puff.lore.rare: Puffs itself up bigger whenever someone says it looks small.
x_cream_puff.lore.epic: Fired its cream across the room at a party and gave the portrait on the wall a beard.
x_cream_puff.lore.legendary: Was so light that it floated out of the bakery and became a weather balloon. Its forecast: cloudy, with a chance of cream.

x_crepe.lore.rare: Folds itself into any shape it is asked for, so the market stall now sells crepe swans.
x_crepe.lore.epic: Was folded so many times on pancake day that it became a paper fan and cooled the whole kitchen.
x_crepe.lore.legendary: Was so thin that it floated off the griddle like a magic carpet and gave the cook a ride round the market.

x_custard.lore.rare: Grows lumps on purpose whenever anyone says 'no lumps, please'.
x_custard.lore.epic: Was poured over a school pudding so thickly that the dinner lady lost her ladle in it until next term.
x_custard.lore.legendary: Set its skin so thick that the children bounced across the bowl like a trampoline, and nobody fell in.

x_danish.lore.common: Arrives at the meeting looking perfect and leaves it looking as if someone sat on it.
x_danish.lore.epic: Was opened at a big meeting, and the boss got so sticky that he signed every letter with his thumb.
x_danish.lore.legendary: Shed so many layers in one bite that the flakes were swept up and baked into a second danish.

x_dim_sum.lore.rare: Rolls its basket round the table by itself and stops in front of whoever is hungriest.
x_dim_sum.lore.epic: Was stacked so high on Sunday that the tower of baskets swayed like a tree, and the whole restaurant leaned to hold it up.
x_dim_sum.lore.legendary: Served one basket with a dumpling and a smaller basket inside, and so on all the way down to a single crumb.

x_donut_box.lore.rare: Locks its lid whenever the person holding it says they'll only have one.
x_donut_box.lore.epic: Was opened so fast in the office that the sprinkles shot into the printer, and every report came out decorated.
x_donut_box.lore.legendary: Was so big that the office used it as the meeting table, and every meeting has finished early ever since.

x_dumpling.lore.rare: Pinches its pleats round the chopsticks and won't let go until it has been dipped in sauce.
x_dumpling.lore.epic: Was folded at a family party into shapes so odd that one looked exactly like Grandad, and he refused to eat it.
x_dumpling.lore.legendary: Had pleats so perfect that the curtain maker copied them, and now every window in town is dressed like a dumpling.

x_eclair.lore.rare: Grows its chocolate topping back overnight, so somebody licks it off every evening.
x_eclair.lore.epic: Squirted so much cream at the bakery that the baker's hat turned into a meringue.
x_eclair.lore.legendary: Was so shiny that the bakery used it as a mirror, and the baker straightens his hat in it every morning.

x_empanada.lore.uncommon: Has a crimped edge that is always the crunchiest bit and always the first to break off.
x_empanada.lore.rare: Crimps itself shut so tightly that only the person who made it can open it.
x_empanada.lore.epic: Was folded so big at the market that the stallholder used it as an umbrella when it rained.
x_empanada.lore.legendary: Was so spicy that one bite cleared every blocked nose in the market at once, and the tissue stall closed early.

x_enchilada.lore.rare: Spreads its sauce onto anything nearby, so the oven gloves come out red and spicy.
x_enchilada.lore.epic: Was baked in a tray too big for the oven, so the family cooked it on the car roof in the midday sun.
x_enchilada.lore.legendary: Rolled so long in the oven that it came out of the back of the cooker and into the kitchen next door.

x_falafel.lore.uncommon: Rolls off the plate and away down the table whenever it isn't wrapped up.
x_falafel.lore.rare: Bounces like a rubber ball when dropped and has to be chased round the kitchen.
x_falafel.lore.epic: Was rolled so round at a festival that it was used in the football match and scored twice before it was eaten.
x_falafel.lore.legendary: Rolled out of its pita, down the hill and through the whole town like a crunchy snowball, picking up lettuce on the way.

x_french_toast.lore.rare: Soaks up any drink put near it, so the tea, the milk and the orange juice all go missing at breakfast.
x_french_toast.lore.epic: Soaked up so much syrup that it slid off the plate and skated across the kitchen like an ice-hockey puck.
x_french_toast.lore.legendary: Soaked up a whole lake of maple syrup in one slice, and the forest has been trying to get it back ever since.

x_garlic_bread.lore.rare: Makes anyone who eats it whisper, because their breath can blow out a candle.
x_garlic_bread.lore.epic: Was baked so garlicky that the holiday photos came out with green clouds round everyone's mouths.

x_gnocchi.lore.rare: Multiplies in the pot, so a handful for two turns into dinner for the whole street.
x_gnocchi.lore.epic: Was rolled so big at a family party that one gnocchi became the baby's pillow.

x_jello.lore.rare: Wobbles in time to any music in the room, and loses its rhythm completely when Dad sings.
x_jello.lore.epic: Fell on the floor, bounced back onto the plate, and then did it again for an encore.
x_jello.lore.legendary: Wobbled for so long after one tap that it was used to power the town clock, and the clock hands now wiggle.

x_jelly.lore.rare: Hops off the plate when it is shaped like a rabbit, and swims away when it is shaped like a fish.
x_jelly.lore.epic: Was turned out as a giant castle at a birthday party, and the toy soldiers defended it all afternoon before it fell.
x_jelly.lore.legendary: Was turned out so tall that it became the village's jelly mountain, and walkers now carry spoons instead of sticks.

x_marshmallow.lore.epic: Was toasted so big at a campfire that it became a sleeping bag, and the scout leader slept in it.
x_marshmallow.lore.legendary: Toasted so golden that it outshone the campfire, and the campers roasted their sausages on it instead.

x_mousse.lore.rare: Makes everyone at the table speak in a hushed, fancy voice the moment it is served.
x_mousse.lore.epic: Drifted out of an open window at a fancy dinner and settled on the garden gnome like a chocolate hat.

x_muffin_top.lore.rare: Swells over the edge of the tin until it joins the muffin next door, so every batch comes out as one giant top.
x_muffin_top.lore.epic: Was pulled off every muffin at a party, and the abandoned bottoms formed a band and played a very sad song.
x_muffin_top.lore.legendary: Pulled itself off every muffin in the bakery and became one giant top, which now has a shop of its own.

x_nachos.lore.rare: Stretches its cheese between every chip, so picking up one lifts the whole plate.
x_nachos.lore.epic: Was piled so high on film night that it blocked the TV, and the family watched the film through a gap in the chips.
x_nachos.lore.legendary: Was piled so high that a mountain goat climbed it for the view and stayed for the guacamole.

x_pancake_stack.lore.epic: Was flipped so high on pancake day that the top pancake landed on the washing line and dried in the sun.
x_pancake_stack.lore.legendary: Was stacked so high that the top pancake had to be flipped by a passing helicopter.

x_pastry.lore.uncommon: Puffs up so much in the oven that it hides the filling completely.
x_pastry.lore.rare: Takes the shape of whatever it is draped over, so the baker now sells pastry hats, pastry shoes and a pastry cat.
x_pastry.lore.epic: Was rolled out so thin that the wind caught it like a sail and blew it out to sea.
x_pastry.lore.legendary: Puffed up so high in the oven that it became the bakery's golden dome, and pigeons nest in its flakes.

x_pie_slice.lore.uncommon: Is always cut slightly bigger than everyone else's, and everyone notices.
x_pie_slice.lore.rare: Grows back into a whole pie if it is left on the plate overnight.
x_pie_slice.lore.epic: Was cut so badly at a party that the slice went one way, the filling went the other, and the crust went home with the dog.
x_pie_slice.lore.legendary: Was cut so exactly that the knife became the town's official ruler, and every road is now measured in pie slices.

x_pudding.lore.uncommon: Gets announced at the start of dinner, so nobody can concentrate on their peas.
x_pudding.lore.epic: Was so popular at Sunday lunch that the vegetables tried to hide inside it.
x_pudding.lore.legendary: Wobbled at exactly the right speed to rock a crying baby to sleep, and it now has a job at the nursery.

x_ravioli.lore.rare: Folds itself into a little parcel and posts itself to whoever is hungriest.
x_ravioli.lore.epic: Got stuck together in one long chain, and the family pulled it out of the pan like a magician's scarf.
x_ravioli.lore.legendary: Held a whole dinner in one pocket: soup, pasta and a tiny trifle at the very end.

x_samosa.lore.rare: Sneezes a puff of spice in the face of anyone who calls it a pasty by mistake.
x_samosa.lore.epic: Was stacked into a pyramid at a party, and a tourist took a photo thinking it was the real thing.
x_samosa.lore.legendary: Was so perfectly triangular that it was used to mend the roof of a house, and the attic now smells of cumin.

x_sausage_roll.lore.common: Is a sausage in flaky pastry that is always too hot inside and too cold outside.
x_sausage_roll.lore.uncommon: Leaves its sausage behind in the bag and arrives at the picnic as an empty tube.
x_sausage_roll.lore.epic: Was baked so long for the picnic that it became the finishing line for the sack race.
x_sausage_roll.lore.legendary: Was baked in one piece long enough to go round the park, and the joggers nibble a bit each lap.

x_scone.lore.rare: Splits itself in half the moment the jam jar is opened, ready to be filled.
x_scone.lore.epic: Started such a jam-or-cream argument at a garden party that a fence was built down the middle of the field.

x_spring_roll.lore.epic: Unrolled in the fryer and came out as one long golden ribbon, which the family hung up as decorations.
x_spring_roll.lore.legendary: Crunched once so loudly that the sound rolled down the river, and the boats pulled over to let it pass.

x_tamale.lore.epic: Was made by the whole family in one day, and somebody wrapped Grandma's glasses in a husk and steamed them too.
x_tamale.lore.legendary: Was wrapped so many times that unwrapping it became the town's longest party game, and the last layer came off on New Year's Day.

x_tart.lore.rare: Sets its glaze so hard that the fruit can be heard tapping on the inside to get out.
x_tart.lore.epic: Shone so brightly in the bakery window that a magpie flew off with the whole tart, plate and all.

x_tiramisu.lore.rare: Wakes anyone who eats it so thoroughly that they tidy their room at midnight.
x_tiramisu.lore.epic: Was dusted with so much cocoa that the dinner party sneezed in chorus and the tablecloth turned brown.
x_tiramisu.lore.legendary: Lifted the spirits of a gloomy rain cloud so well that it rained sprinkles over the town.

x_toast.lore.rare: Grows its crusts back every time they are cut off, which annoys every child at breakfast.
x_toast.lore.legendary: Fell butter side up so often that it broke the law of buttered toast, and now the cat lands on its back instead.

x_waffle_plate.lore.rare: Fills each square with a different topping by itself, and one square is always broccoli.
x_waffle_plate.lore.epic: Was stacked into a tower so tall that children used the squares as a climbing wall.
x_waffle_plate.lore.legendary: Was laid out so big on the beach that it became a giant game of noughts and crosses, and the tide always wins.

x_yogurt.lore.rare: Curdles any milk stored next to it, so the fridge door is full of very surprised cheese.
x_yogurt.lore.legendary: Was shaken so hard on a school trip that it turned into butter, then cheese, then a very small cow.
